"''Copy, ''Chimaera'', transmitting codes now.|TYA77 prepares to land aboard the ''Chimaera''|}} '''Shuttle TYA77''' was a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] that transported [[Ezra Bridger]] to the ''[[Chimaera]]'' along with [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] and [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]]. ==Description== As a [[Sentinel-class landing craft]], Shuttle TYA77 had a tri-wing design. It was stationed aboard [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]]'s [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] and was used to ferry passengers. ==History== In [[2 BBY]], Shuttle TYA77 ferried [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] and [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]] from Lyste's light cruiser to [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]''. They were accompanied by the captured [[bounty hunter]] [[Ezra Bridger]] and the droids [[C1-10P|Chopper]] and [[AP-5]]. Lyste had brought the former as a trophy to showcase his triumph while Chopper and AP-5 had come on the pretext of presenting evidence against Ezra for stealing a [[Star Commuter 2000]] [[shuttle]] from [[Lothal]]'s [[Capital City spaceport]]. In reality, Ezra and the droids were part of a rebel plot to rescue Kallus, who was secretly the rebel informant known as [[Fulcrum]]. ==Behind the scenes== Shuttle TYA77 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Through Imperial Eyes]]," which premiered on [[February 25]], [[2017]]. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Through Imperial Eyes}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{Databank|imperial-sentinel-class-shuttle|Imperial ''Sentinel''-Class Shuttle}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Sentinel-class landing craft]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Empire]]
